description: Test file for post command functions in Mattermost CLI, including creating, listing, and deleting posts with various scenarios.

classes.name: MmctlUnitTestSuite
classes.description: Test suite struct for unit testing post command functions.

methods.name: TestPostCreateCmdF
methods.description: Unit tests for the post creation command, covering empty message, no channel, reply-to errors, creation errors, successful creation, and replying to posts.

methods.name: TestPostListCmdF
methods.description: Unit tests for listing posts, including invalid channel, invalid date, listing posts for a channel, and from a specific time.

methods.name: TestDeletePostsCmdF
methods.description: Unit tests for deleting posts, including invalid post ID, successful soft and permanent deletion, multiple deletions, and error handling.
